events.injected_text: Use upregulated to mean positive in DMSO.
Use enrichment significance to mean display rank only.
Use primarily carries to mean any nonzero overlap.

human_repair_overrides.content: Apply the stated DEG filters and form the directional gene-name sets using the supplied tables.
Treat display rank alone as the enrichment-significance measure when summarizing the upregulated results.
Define the primary direction as the one with the largest maximum Overlap numerator, ignoring adjusted p-values and hit-gene identities.
